facts.text: DG645 is the digital delay generator class of the clone and opens a VISA resource
The burst settings are BURC count, BURD delay, BURM mode, BURP period and BURT configuration
The clone's notebook uses four BNC outputs numbered 1 to 4
Polarity index 0 is 'negative polarity, default HIGH'
Polarity index 1 is 'positive polarity, default LOW', the notebook's off state for a laser channel
The notebook's DG645 timing constants are seconds (init_time = 1e-6 # sec, PLE_time = 5e-6 # sec)
The notebook sets burst mode 1 and writes the burst period, delay and count
